title: 2003 HMMT February General Round 1 Problem 8
statement: A broken calculator has the + and \(\times\) keys switched. For how many ordered pairs \((a, b)\) of integers will it correctly calculate \(a+b\) using the labelled + key?

solutions.text:
2
We need \(a+b=a b\), or \(a=\frac{b}{b-1}=1-\frac{1}{b-1}\), so \(1 /(b-1)\) is an integer. Thus \(b\) must be 0 or 2 , and \(a\) is 0 or 2 , respectively. So there are 2 .
